steps.en: On a clean 4-core / 8 GB Linux server, run the quick-start script
steps.zh: 在一台干净的 4 核 8 GB Linux 上跑快速开始脚本

steps.en: Installs Docker and starts core, KoKo, Chen, web, PostgreSQL and Redis
steps.zh: 装好 Docker，拉起核心、连接器、PostgreSQL 和 Redis

steps.en: Log in as admin, add assets and their accounts, grant users access
steps.zh: 以 admin 登录，录入资产和账号，给用户授权

steps.en: Engineers open sessions from the web terminal instead of holding passwords
steps.zh: 工程师从网页终端发起会话，手里不再有密码

steps.en: Checks the permission, fills in the stored credential and proxies the session
steps.zh: 校验授权，代填保管的凭据，转发会话

steps.en: Records the session and every command for replay and audit
steps.zh: 录下会话和每条命令，供回放和审计

value.en: Nobody holds production passwords anymore, and every privileged session has a named owner and a replayable record
value.zh: 再没人手握生产密码，每个特权会话都有具名责任人和可回放记录
